findings.defect: The Korean repeats “교감과 감정” (“connection and feelings”). This rendering narrows the echo to how people feel and drops the idea of connection.
findings.rationale: The preceding line already names the difficulty as “the connections and feelings between people,” and Ju Hwaran repeats those same concepts before saying she understands the feeling.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall. One minor echo loses the specific idea of connection present in the Korean.
